text: A woman with red hair, long and wavy, stands in a ruined setting. She has an hourglass build, fair skin, and an oval face with defined eyes. Wearing a translucent white gown with high slits and a dark belt, she accessorizes with bracelets and a choker. One hand rests on her hip, the other near her head. Barefoot, she poses confidently amid stone ruins under a starry night sky. A torch glows faintly in the background.
